plan.title: Saved eRFX draft hides vendor-addition icon

steps.note: Open the Events list to reach saved drafts.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the tenant configuration under test.
Apply the additional tenant configuration specified for the draft.
Confirm the events list rendered successfully.
Switch to the Drafts tab specified by the scenario.
Open the first saved draft and land on its draft create screen.
Confirm the selected saved draft is open.
Attempt the closest available assertion that the named icon is not visible; the icon-only control has no confirmed catalog label.
